sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact executor is acquired before try, retained by this JUnit test, and every exit executes finally shutdownNow plus awaitTermination10s with a failing resource-postcondition assertion. Each of64 Future joins has5s bound. Implicit close can wait unbounded; no leaked or ignored owner.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact site belongs to whole pure value JUnit Test, not managed J2EE webapp. Eight owned workers run64 fixed literal byte/lookup/navigation tasks, each Future joins5s, every exit finally shutdownNow/await10s verifies termination. No process/native/service/authorization action.
